scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,client,fetcher -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev --prefix servers/cloud/backend" "npm run dev --prefix client" "npm run dev:fetcher"
scripts.stack: npm run --silent doppler -- docker compose -f servers/cloud/compose.yaml up --build
scripts.doppler: set -a; [ -f servers/cloud/.env ] && . ./servers/cloud/.env; set +a; exec mise exec -- doppler run --
scripts.dev:fetcher: until curl -sf http://localhost:3001/contract > /dev/null; do sleep 1; done && cd servers/cloud/youtube-fetcher && { set -a; [ -f ../.env ] && . ../.env; set +a; exec mise exec -- doppler run -- .venv/bin/python app/app.py; }
scripts.dev:local: cd servers/local && mise exec -- npm run dev
scripts.start:local: cd servers/local && mise exec -- sh -c 'npm run build --prefix ../../client && npm run build && npm run start:api'
